exceptions.detail: The four long balanced edge-decomposition cycles in exercise 83 were not exhaustively traced; the modular product construction in 81–82 was checked. The all-even-dimensional decomposition theorem cited in 82 was accepted as an external result.

The Loony Loop state sequence in 84 was compared with the ternary Gray path and the printed diagrams, without reproducing the physical three-dimensional cord motions. The specific length-15 successor string in 89(b) was not independently reconstructed; its successor rule and the general recurrence were reviewed. Historical attributions and the more general external generation algorithms cited in 91 were retained without reconstructing those papers.
